Plans a merge, replace, delete, rename or new-table change and returns what it would do - the counts, the new and changed rows, the findings (duplicates, missing To codes, Excel-date codes, and To codes not in or not active in the official list) and the base and result revisions - without writing anything. Rows come as JSON or as a CSV file (base64); no file text is accepted. The Map view may preview against base_text; include_text returns the file a save would write.
